note: `(case k (a b) :r …)` — a LIST in a constant position is a group of unevaluated constants, never an invocation (the fabricated `calls a`); result positions still walk (`(helper)` emits). W23 (review finding): `case`'s optional trailing DEFAULT sits at index N-1 — an EVEN index whenever present — so a LIST-shaped default was skipped by the same parity rule and its calls silently vanished from BOTH sides (mirrored). Defaults are expressions and always walk: `(helper-default k)` in h (one pair + default) and j (zero pairs + default) emits.
